us.title: 'Funflation' is on the rise as hobbies get pricier, but consumers keep spending anyway
us.summary: Consumers are spending more on hobbies like arts and crafts and outdoor sports, as it gets more expensive to travel due to increased airfare. 'Funflation' is on the rise as hobbies get pricier, but consumers keep spending anyway

us.summary: Boeing identified a software issue on some 737 Max aircraft that can affect automated vertical navigation functions after a missed approach. Boeing flags 737 Max software glitch affecting some automated approach functions
